Title: The LORD Himself Will Shepherd His Flock
Promise: God himself would search for his scattered sheep, seek them out as a shepherd seeks a scattered flock, gather them from the peoples, feed them on good pasture, seek the lost, bring back the driven away, bind up the broken, and strengthen the sick.
KeyScriptures: Ezekiel 34:11; Ezekiel 34:12; Ezekiel 34:13; Ezekiel 34:14; Ezekiel 34:15; Ezekiel 34:16
